name: ledger
description:
Record and query personal income and expenses.
Amounts are number strings like "35.50". A foreign currency is converted into the book's currency automatically and the rate is stored on the entry. The add result carries a budget field when a monthly budget is near or past its limit. An account balance converts entries in other currencies at the rate frozen on each entry. Books, accounts, categories and budgets belong to manage_ledger.

action.description: add records, list browses, summary reports a period, update edits, delete removes.

amount.description: For add and update: a number string like 35.50.

kind.description: For add and list: expense by default. A transfer moves money between two accounts.

currency.description: For add: an ISO code like JPY. Defaults to the book's currency.

category.description: For add, list and update: the category name. Optional. On add and update a name that does not exist yet is created right there, and the result says so; list never creates one.

account.description: For add and list: which account the money paid out of. Optional. Every book starts with 现金, 电子支付, 交通卡, 信用卡 and 银行卡. For a transfer it is the source.

to_account.description: For add with kind=transfer: the destination account.

note.description: For add and update: what it was for, including the shop.

date.description: For add and update: 2026-09-08. Defaults to today.

period.description: For list and summary: a month like 2026-09, or a range like 2026-09-01..2026-09-15. Defaults to this month. summary takes a month only.

query.description: For list: match text in notes.

book.description: Which book. Only needed when more than one exists.

id.description: For update and delete: the entry id, or a unique prefix of it.

force.description: For add: record even when an identical entry exists from minutes ago.
